inputs.description: Arquitectura objetivo para macOS (arm64 = M1/M2/M3, x86_64 = Intel)

tasks.label: build-compiler-cpp
tasks.detail: Compila el código fuente del compilador (C++)

tasks.label: compile-utopia-file
tasks.detail: Compila el archivo .utp actual usando el binario utopia

windows.command: cmake -S . -B build_release -A ${input:winArch} -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build_release --config Release && cpack --config build_release/CPackConfig.cmake -C Release -G NSIS

osx.command: cmake -S . -B build_release -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="${input:macArch}" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build_release && cpack --config build_release/CPackConfig.cmake -G DragNDrop

linux.command: cmake -S . -B build_release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build_release && cpack --config build_release/CPackConfig.cmake -G RPM
